title: Purification of Haustoria from Arabidopsis in Response to Infection by E. cichoracearum
author: Harley King
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tqkemuw

steps.title: Prepare and grind Arabidopsis leaves
steps.instruction: Grind 5-10g of frozen Arabidopsis leaves in ice-cold 1x PBS buffer (pH 7.4) using a kitchen blender in a cold room.

substeps.instruction: Set aside 2-3 leaves for confocal microscope quantification before purification.
Add 8 mL of 1x PBS buffer (pH 7.4) and grind for 1 min.

steps.title: Perform initial filtration
steps.instruction: Filter the grindate through a 100um Nylon mesh.

substeps.instruction: Use a glass rod to remove unfiltered debris from the mesh back into the blender.
Use a transfer pipette to wash the membrane with PBS buffer into the blender.

steps.title: Repeat grinding and filtration
steps.instruction: Perform a second round of grinding and filtration to maximize yield.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 mL of 1x PBS buffer and grind for another 45 seconds.
Filter the resulting grindate through a 100um Nylon mesh.

steps.title: Fine filtration and concentration
steps.instruction: Pass the combined filtrates through a 40um mesh to isolate haustoria (approx. 10-20um in diameter).

substeps.instruction: Combine filtrates from the 100um mesh steps and pass through a 40um mesh (a vacuum and modified filter assembly may be used).
Wash the membrane with PBS buffer into the trash.
Pass the filtrate through the 40um mesh a second time.
Transfer ~13-15mL of filtrate to a 15mL conical tube.
Pellet the filtrate at 1000g for 5 min and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Quantify and verify haustoria
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 2mL 1x PBS buffer and verify haustoria presence.

substeps.instruction: Set aside a 40ul aliquot for quantification.
Investigate haustoria using a confocal microscope and a hemacytometer.
Process Col-0 plants concurrently as a negative control.

steps.title: Percoll gradient centrifugation
steps.instruction: Purify haustoria using a discontinuous Percoll gradient.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 60% and 40% Percoll solutions using 1x PBS.
Layer 4mL of 60% Percoll solution at the bottom of a 15mL conical tube.
Layer 6mL of 40% Percoll solution on top of the 60% layer.
Gently add 1mL of the resuspended pellet to the top of the 40% layer.
Centrifuge at 2500g for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Recover and concentrate Percoll fraction
steps.instruction: Collect the haustoria that penetrated the 40% layer but not the 60% layer.

substeps.instruction: Remove the 40% layer.
Mix the recovered fraction and pellet at 1000g for 5 min.
Resuspend in 2mL.
Remove a 40ul aliquot for quantification; proceed if sufficient.

steps.title: Immunomagnetic purification
steps.instruction: Use anti-GFP Trap antibody conjugated beads to isolate haustoria.

substeps.instruction: Conjugate anti-GFP Trap antibody to Dynabeads according to the manufacturer's protocol.
Incubate beads with haustoria with end-over-end rotation overnight.
Wash beads 5x with 1x PBS (pH 7.4).
Disrupt haustoria-GFP Trap binding following the manufacturer's protocol.

steps.title: FACS purification
steps.instruction: Perform FACS purification using Col-0 plants as a negative control and previous experiments as a baseline.
